description.blurb: Gunnlod (formerly S/2004 S32 and Saturn LXII) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Gunnlod is a Norse giantess, and a daughter of Suttungr, for whom she guards the mead of poetry. Gunnlod is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1153.96 days, at an inclination of 159° to the ecliptic.
